messages:
maria-ss: Hey team, SoundByte reporting intermittent tool-call arg truncation when using streaming (SSE). They say the JSON payload for the tool args sometimes ends mid-object. Posting their minimal repro snippet below.
soundbyte-prod: here's the raw stream chunk we got from their edge: `...
{"action":"charge.create","args":{"amount":499,"currency":"USD","metadata":{"user_id":"u-123` 
then nothing — connection stays open but the JSON is incomplete. Happens ~2% of requests.
samir: Thanks. Do we know which layer is closing or flushing the chunk? SSE vs websocket vs proxy? Any request_id?
soundbyte-prod: SSE to hosted API, function name `charge.create`, stream=true. Request id = req_2026_abc123. We forwarded proxy logs. Non-streaming (regular POST) works.
jess: suspicious — sounds like chunk boundary split by LB or keepalive flush. ingress-proxy logs for that window show some `flush mid-chunk` warnings.
ingress-proxy: log excerpt: `2026-02-18T10:12:34Z WARN conn=1234 flush mid-chunk bytes_sent=1024 reason=flush_on_timer` — likely timer-based flush while JSON building.
samir: Repro plan: 1) Ask customer to run a `curl -N` SSE test against our endpoint with `--raw` and capture raw bytes. 2) Send us request_id and timestamp (we have req_2026_abc123). 3) Try same call with streaming disabled to confirm. 4) If possible, provide a pcap or tcpdump of the exchange.
maria-ss: Suggested workaround to customer: wrap tool args as base64 string in the stream so chunk splits don't produce invalid JSON, or send as a single non-streamed request while we investigate. Example wrapper: ```json
{"tool_args_b64":"eyJhY3Rpb24iOiAiY2hhcmdlLmNyZWF0ZSIsICJhcmdzIjogeyJhbW91bnQiOiA0OTl9fQ=="}
```
soundbyte-prod: Will try base64 wrapper. Confirmed non-stream POST succeeds. We'll run curl raw and attach payloads.
jess: Created internal debug trace and pinned ingress-proxy instance; planning a patch to avoid timer flush when Transfer-Encoding is chunked with small in-flight packets. Rollout target: tomorrow morning.
support-bot: Ticket created: SUP-8241. Linked request_id=req_2026_abc123 and attached initial logs.
samir: I'll pick this up with infra and LB team. If customer can provide raw capture we can rule out their intermediate proxy. Thanks — will update in SUP-8241. :eyes:
maria-ss: keeping customer updated, asked them to try base64 and to share curl `--raw` output. :thumbsup:
